dws_group: management, business, and financial operations occupations
note: 1980-census executive/administrative/managerial maps directly onto the modern management and business/financial operations group.
1980-census professional specialty maps directly onto the modern professional and related group.

Protective service is a subset of the modern service occupations group.

The 1980-census precision production bucket does not map cleanly onto one modern group; production occupations is the closest single target but the boundary is judgement rather than a clean crosswalk.
